entry: Next observed session open after closing signal
exit: Close of holding session; trades crossing partition boundaries are excluded
selection: One per family; dev>=50,val>=20,dev and val net5>0; rank min(dev net5,val net5). Holdout not used.
bootstrap: 3000 moving ten-session blocks, indexed by entry session; conditional, no multiplicity adjustment
special_sessions: Included as published daily observations; a session need not have regular duration
